PLAN_COMPTABLE.X3: SELECT ACC_0, DES_0 FROM [{base}].[{table}].[GACCOUNT]  where COA_0= 'MGA'

BLG.X3:
SELECT GACCENTRYD.ACC_0,'' AS DESIGNATION, SUM(AMTLED_0*SNS_0) FROM {table}.GACCENTRYD 
WHERE GACCENTRYD.CPY_0='{value}' AND YEAR(GACCENTRYD.ACCDAT_0)='{target}' AND GACCENTRYD.LED_0='MGA'
GROUP BY GACCENTRYD.ACC_0
BLG.SAGE100:
SELECT F_ECRITUREC.CG_Num, '' AS DESIGNATION, sum(CASE WHEN EC_Sens=1 THEN -EC_Montant ELSE EC_Montant END  ) FROM F_ECRITUREC 


WHERE YEAR(JM_DATE)='{target}'
GROUP BY F_ECRITUREC.CG_Num
